about: Source for transparency/library-evals.html, built by build/transparency/build.py. Scores come from the retrieval test in the team's document library (library/evals/results.csv in the working folder). Add a run here whenever the test is re-run after a change, newest last. Counts are out of the questions of that kind in the test at the time; each run's `of` gives its answerable total.

runs.change: First build. Keyword and meaning search combined
Each passage indexed with its document title and section
Running headers and footers removed from PDFs
runs.decision: Kept, but the step also deleted table values (E-2026-46) and was corrected after verification

runs.change: How the two rankings are combined, four settings tried
runs.decision: Original setting kept. The others were no better or worse

runs.change: Less weight on keyword matching, four settings tried
runs.decision: Rejected. Every reduction was worse, and meaning alone (shown) was worst

runs.change: Answer key corrected after verification, value checks added, three no-answer questions added
runs.decision: All later scores use the corrected test (E-2026-47)

runs.change: Updated Green Book (28 October 2026) added, three questions re-keyed to it
runs.decision: Kept. The test now requires the current discount rate

runs.change: Reranker added, a second model that reads the question and each passage together
Two places in the top five reserved for the first-stage rankings, to protect tables
runs.decision: Reverted. It pushed out correct answers

runs.change: Those passages added after the top five instead, and a stricter not-in-library flag
The December LEA's Policy Reference Set added (19 documents, library tripled) with eight questions on them
runs.decision: Kept. Scores fell, as expected when a library grows

runs.change: Reranker blended with the first-stage ranking, and a larger shortlist tried
runs.decision: Blend kept, larger shortlist rejected (no gain). The original 21 questions score 18 in the top five, against 19 before the set was added

runs.change: Methodology and standards added, 30 documents covering ONS quality and methodology notes, the Magenta and AQuA Books, the Code of Practice and appraisal guidance, with ten questions on them
runs.decision: Kept. Current setting. The new questions score 9 of 10 in the top five; two original appraisal questions fell out of the top five but stay in the top eight
